subject: Resale & referral splits + demo credit ops for Assimilate
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@assimilate.io>, Laura Nguyen <laura@assimilate.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Resale & referral splits + demo credit ops for Assimilate

Tom / Laura —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion I wanted to capture an operational starting point we can use for your internal approvals and for legal to draft the reseller addendum. High-level proposal:

- Resale (white-label / resell): wholesale discount to Assimilate of 30% off list price for deals you close and invoice directly. Tiered uplift: 35% wholesale if annualized ARR through Redwood exceeds $75k in a rolling 12mo.
- Referral: for leads you refer where Redwood invoices directly, Assimilate receives 12% of first-year ARR credited as a one-time referral payment.
- Demo credits: Assimilate gets 3 demo credits (each credit = $2,000 token/demo credit) to cover POC/demo hosting for prospects; credits are one-time, not refundable, expire after 180 days.
- Lead registration: 120-day registration window from first intro; claims must be submitted with contact and timestamp. 60-day claim review SLA.
- Clawback: referral payments are subject to 6-month pro-rata clawback if the customer churns within the first 6 months.

Attached is a draft MSA and an example SOW template for how we typically list reseller terms. If this looks directionally correct, next steps: 1) Assimilate confirms acceptance in principle, 2) we open a HubSpot deal and assign a mutual action plan (I started a draft link below), 3) legal prepares a reseller addendum for signatures.

Open to tweaks on the demo-credit sizing or tier thresholds — wanted to avoid running these as one-off exceptions.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Resale & referral splits + demo credit ops for Assimilate

Thanks Grace — this is a very helpful starting point. A few clarifying Qs from our finance/procurement side: 

1) For resale discount tiers, can you confirm whether Assimilate bills customers and collects revenue (wholesale model) or whether Redwood invoices and pays a credit to Assimilate (referral model)? I think you proposed both depending on the motion — want to be explicit for our procurement.
2) Are demo credits transferrable between prospects or limited to a specific customer? Also: how do you handle overages if a POC goes beyond the credit value?
3) For the referral 12% — is that net of discounts and credits or based on gross ARR? We need to show projected margins to our CFO.
4) We need a one-page commercial table (price list + reseller net) to include in an internal PO request. Can you provide that?

If you want, Laura (cc'd) is our procurement lead — she can share the PO template and any contract redlines up front.

—Tom
Tom Briggs
Head of Partnerships | Assimilate Inc.
Tom.Briggs@assimilate.io | +1 212 555 0172
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@assimilate.io>, Laura Nguyen <laura@assimilate.io>

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resale & referral splits + demo credit ops for Assimilate

Tom — great questions, appreciate the precision. Answers inline below and a short commercial table at the bottom to save back-and-forth.

1) Resale vs referral:
   - Wholesale (resale): Assimilate invoices customers directly. Redwood provides a reseller invoice with list pricing so Assimilate can set their sale price. Assimilate collects revenue and remits payment to Redwood at the net (post-wholesale) amount per the reseller invoice schedule.
   - Referral: If Assimilate registers a lead but Redwood invoices directly, Assimilate receives a 12% referral payment on first-year net ARR.

2) Demo credits: transferable between prospects inside Assimilate's pipeline; they are consumed on a per-deal basis. Overages billed at list price; we will proactively notify when 80% of a credit is used.

3) Referral base: 12% is calculated on first-year net ARR after customer discounts but before credits are applied. We will show both gross and net columns in the commercial table.

Commercial table (summary):
- List price: $100k per standard slot (example).
- Reseller wholesale discount: 30% (net to Redwood = $70k). Tier: 35% if annualized ARR thru Redwood > $75k.
- Referral fee: 12% of FY1 net ARR (paid as one-time commission within 45 days of customer payment).
- Demo credits: 3 credits x $2,000 = $6,000 total (one-time).
- Lead registration / claim window: 120 days from first intro; 60-day review SLA.
- Clawback: pro-rata over 6 months if customer cancels; clawback schedule included in reseller addendum.

Next steps: I'll upload a one-page commercial table + the reseller addendum draft to the HubSpot deal and share a mutual action plan. Laura, if you can drop your PO template we can map the line items.

Best,

Grace
Sr. Partner Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Assimilate — quick internal alignment on commercial ask

Grace / Marissa —

Agree with the proposed defaults. A couple of operational asks from GTM/finance so legal doesn't have to iterate: 
- Make the reseller discount effective on signed addendum date and allow retrospective application only if Assimilate submits signed customer order with date within 30 days of addendum effective date.
- For referral payments, finance wants payout on receipt of customer payment (not invoice date) to avoid bad debt exposure. 45-day payout after receipt is fine.
- Ensure we include short clause about demo-credit accounting (non-refundable credit that offsets invoice line items) so accounting knows where to apply credits.

I'll flag to legal to draft the reseller addendum with these bullets. If Marissa can loop in Legal Ops, we should aim for a redline within 5 business days after we get Assimilate's PO template.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Head of GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
